hypothesis: At exact c32 depth-12 target verification, restricting the five 55-local/5-global proxy layers to TARGET_VERIFY and maintaining mirrored stock/proxy KV banks can preserve the stock path before verification and after accepted-prefix cache movement while retaining a positive net target-cycle saving.

bench.reuse_contract: Reuse the registered resident exact checkpoint, pinned SGLang image and source, compiler and CUDA caches. Do not provision, recreate, drain, or otherwise mutate provider lifecycle.

scope.workload: One exact c32, 4,214-token prefill followed by one ordinary stock decode row, one 384-row depth-12 TARGET_VERIFY replay, one synthetic accepted-index move/free pattern mirrored across both KV banks, and one post-accept stock-operator decode.

quality_gate: Stock prefill and the pre-verification ordinary decode are bit-exact to the pinned control.
All 384 logical TARGET_VERIFY rows use the proxy only at converted layers; padded rows allocate and write no cache slot.
Stock and proxy cache banks undergo identical allocation, write, accepted-index move, and rejected-row free operations.
The post-accept stock-operator decode is finite and exact against an eager dual-cache reference.
CUDA-graph replay does not recapture or introduce host synchronization.
Measured gross target-cycle saving minus shadow-KV projection, write, move, and dispatch costs is positive.

measurement.timing: Profiler-off CUDA events with warmup and repeated control/candidate samples; report median, p95, dispersion, and repetitions.
telemetry: forward mode, graph batch, logical and padded rows
layer-11 stock/proxy attention-output maximum and relative error
accepted indices and both cache locations before and after move/free
pre-verification and post-accept stock logits versus their exact references
gross target-cycle time, every shadow-maintenance cost, and net time

stop_rules: Stop before timing if any stock-path, row-ownership, cache-lifecycle, or graph gate fails.
Return a typed negative terminal if net component saving is nonpositive; do not repair by weakening exactness or omitting shadow maintenance.
Do not run an endpoint, reopen permanent 55-local/5-global placement, or claim quality preservation or deployability.

budgets.compute: At most 34 claimed H200 minutes at $2.45/hour.
budgets.wall_clock: Claim no later than 2026-07-25T21:18:00Z and release no later than 2026-07-25T21:52:00Z.
budgets.storage: At most 3 GiB of new non-checkpoint artifacts.

artifact_contract.required_classification: exact_positive_net_component | exact_nonpositive_net_component | semantic_or_cache_reject | graph_contract_reject | claim_gate_expired | infrastructure_terminal
artifact_contract.cleanup: Stop all project processes and release the bench ready with resident reusable state preserved.
